annotations.title: A player's Desk level and record

description: Returns the Desk's read of a named player: their Desk level, their record by season, team, stage and format, the model card id and the lines behind it. Call it when someone asks how strong a player is, or about their rating, level, trend or bump risk. The USTA band is not here, because it is the `rating` on a query_roster row. The chat gives no bump prediction; the Desk's one frozen year-end forecast is on the player's page.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

player.description: Player name to resolve, e.g. 'First Last'. Or the player's Desk page link or number.
